title: Cross-Signal Anomaly of the Day
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| stats latest(zscore) as z, latest(detail) as detail by signal
| where abs(z)>2.5
| sort - z
description: Scans every personal metric at once and surfaces the one behaving most abnormally today.
value: A single anomaly-of-the-day cuts through dashboards to tell you the one thing actually worth a look.
implementation: Compute per-signal z-scores across `index=personal`; surface the day's biggest outliers.
visualization: Table of the most anomalous personal signals today.
grandmaExplanation: It scans all your personal data at once and points out the one thing that is most unusual today.
